component: Qwen3.8 packed external-DFlash scheduling, varlen row geometry, lane-budget policy, and exact-law proposal composition
origin: Original mlx2 implementation. No external implementation source was copied. Existing TensorFold-derived mechanisms retain their separate provenance records and pinned license notices.
modifications: Hold a declared external-DFlash cohort at the prompt/decode boundary until every surviving member reaches decode.
Distinguish scheduler-phase waits from memory-admission waits for serving stall-watchdog accounting.
Clear idle allocator scratch after the final external lane retires.
Validate, apply, and receipt adapter-declared tree node budgets by active lane width while preserving fixed-15 defaults.
Add a bounded, receipt-visible tensorfold_cohort_limit policy control for reproducible cohort-geometry experiments without legacy environment overrides.
Route multi-lane tree verification through TensorFold's pinned packed multi_tree_forward and grouped commit_streams primitives, with physical packed-forward receipts.
Declare a Qwen3.8 packed varlen/tree lane window of 128 rows and retain the same row-invariant law above it by explicit row-axis chunking.
Prefer three DFlash proposals, enforce a Qwen policy minimum of two, clamp the default to configured draft width, and permit only terminal headroom to shorten a round.
Expose adapter-policy sources, chunked lane calls, proposal-floor raises, and physical packed target forwards in status and Prometheus receipts.
Emit a paired verified-span:accepted-draft histogram so live evidence can distinguish strict partial commits from independent span and acceptance marginals.
Declare DFlash2's published selector distributions as stochastic exact laws and preserve those laws on external rows when PLD or native-MTP point masses replace selected rows.
Remove the obsolete cpg_used field from paired GPU-lock receipts and retire child process groups on interruption.

cpu.result: The final focused and broader adaptive/composition/hybrid/varlen/lane/Qwen/TensorFold-bridge/metrics suites passed with the worktree source under paired GPU locks. The paired span/accept receipt test and the full DFlash/tree/adaptive/Qwen regression set also passed. gpu.scope: source-bound candidate performance and mechanism evidence on Apple M5 Max, 128 GiB, MLX 0.32.3
gpu.result: The context ladder and earlier campaigns retain their stated boundaries. A current-source correction run observed one physical TensorFold target forward per packed cohort round, B1-equivalent greedy hashes at B2 and B4, adapter-selected 128-row lane geometry, a three-proposal DFlash floor, 38,336 eliminated layer-level MLP padding rows, and 496 above-window chunked projection calls on a skewed B4 prompt cohort. The 16-row MPP block passed 38/38 all-format small cases and 4/4 Qwen model shapes, was neutral at B1/B2, and moved the diagnostic B4 code/chat cells from 61.52/22.45 to 64.49/23.70 tok/s per lane. A 16K exact-law ordinary/tree comparison produced identical 64-token output and receipt-proved three full-tree strict partial commits, one zero-accept rollback, and three full accepts. These are diagnostic observations, not controlled performance claims or full route qualification.
